text: package contains Campbell (1905) cortical atlas ggseg ecosystem, based supplementary materials Pijnenburg et al., NeuroImage, 239, 2021 (DOI). Campbell .W. (1905). Histological Studies Localisation Cerebral Function. Cambridge University Press. learn use atlases, please look documentation ggseg ggseg3d.

title: Campbell Cortical Atlas (1905) for the ggseg Ecosystem
text: recommend installing ggseg-atlases ggseg r-universe: can install development version ggsegCampbell GitHub :
code: options(repos = c(     ggseg = 'https://ggseg.r-universe.dev',     CRAN = 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))  install.packages('ggsegCampbell') # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("ggseg/ggsegCampbell")

title: Campbell Cortical Atlas (1905) for the ggseg Ecosystem
text: Please note ‘ggsegCampbell’ project released Contributor Code Conduct. contributing project, agree abide terms.
code: library(ggsegCampbell) library(ggseg) library(ggplot2)  ggplot() +   geom_brain(     atlas = campbell(),     mapping = aes(fill = label),     position = position_brain(hemi ~ view),     show.legend = FALSE   ) +   scale_fill_manual(values = campbell()$palette, na.value = "grey") +   theme_void() library(ggseg3d)  ggseg3d(atlas = campbell()) |>   pan_camera("right lateral")

title: Campbell Cortical Atlas (1905) — campbell
text: Brain atlas Campbell (1905) cortical parcellation 17 regions per hemisphere. Contains 2D polygon geometry ggseg::geom_brain() 3D vertex indices ggseg3d::ggseg3d().

title: Campbell Cortical Atlas (1905) — campbell
text: Campbell .W. (1905). Histological studies localisation cerebral function. Cambridge University Press. Pijnenburg R. et al. (2021). Myelo- cytoarchitectonic microstructural functional parcellation human cortex based Campbell atlas. NeuroImage, 239, 118274. doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2021.118274

title: ggsegCampbell: Campbell Cortical Atlas (1905) for the 'ggseg' Ecosystem — ggsegCampbell-package
ggsegCampbell 2.0.0
text: campbell now ggseg_atlas object (ggseg.formats) containing 2D 3D data. separate campbell_3d object removed. Use ggplot() + ggseg::geom_brain(atlas = campbell) 2D plots ggseg3d::ggseg3d(atlas = campbell) 3D plots — object. ggseg.formats now hard dependency (Depends). Package URLs updated LCBC-UiO ggseg GitHub organisation.
